en_US.title: Deep Reach Faction Message Split
en_US.scanner: Message sources conflict: asset recovery, legal silence, old engineering warning.
en_US.terminal: SOURCE SPLIT: Recovery Compliance requests coordinates. Asset Silence rejects publication. Legacy engineering node warns against basin disturbance. Same corporation, different survival instincts.
en_US.audio: A company can be one logo and three knives.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Deep Reach Faction Message Split prevents a flat villain. The corporation is guilty as a system, but present messages can conflict: recovery, silence, engineering caution and liability containment.
en_US.external_site: The Deep Reach threat is stronger when it is institutional, not cartoonish. HECTON-8 lets different offices expose different failures.
en_US.field_note: This is not redemption. It is pressure-source readability.

en_US.title: Blackout Window Signal Decay
en_US.scanner: Signal decay: relay wet, Aegir shadow rising, carrier geometry stale.
en_US.terminal: BLACKOUT WINDOW: packet loss above tolerance. Voice disabled. Legal queue persists. Acoustic relay fallback available only through repaired spine nodes.
en_US.audio: When the sky closes, the paperwork keeps breathing.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Blackout Window Signal Decay keeps communications scarce for physical reasons. The player gets rare windows, broken packets and acoustic relays, not constant radio guidance.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 uses Aegir's orbital and magnetic environment to make silence part of navigation and story structure.
en_US.field_note: Comms cadence degrades by geometry first, then by relay damage; the legal queue keeps ticking through both.
